J.thesis_one_line: Engineering firm riding the data-center, chip and water building boom, with record orders and raised guidance, but profits lean on adjusted numbers.
kill_criteria: Adjusted net revenue growth below 5% year-on-year in any quarter of fiscal 2027 (Q3-26: 8.3%).
TTM adjusted-net-revenue book-to-bill below 1.0x, or backlog down year-on-year in two consecutive quarters (now $28.9B, +27.3%).
Consolidated net debt above 2.5x TTM adjusted EBITDA (now ~1.8x; debt per Note 12 table less cash).
Fiscal 2027 adjusted free cash flow margin guidance below 7.0% of adjusted net revenue (FY26 guide ~8%).
Fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance midpoint below $7.25 (the FY26 midpoint).
key_adverse_facts: 9-month FY26 GAAP net earnings from continuing operations $219M vs adjusted $607M
Receivables and contract assets +25.8% to $3.76B since 26 Sep 2025; Q3 operating cash flow helped by +$295.5M payables
Q3 adjusted-net-revenue book-to-bill only 1.1x vs 1.5x gross; gross revenue +34.5% inflated by pass-through costs
Debt rose to $3.6B principal (net ~1.8x adjusted EBITDA) to fund PA Consulting buyout; goodwill $4.76B vs equity $3.25B
Aug 2026 EPS guidance top end cut ($7.35 to $7.30) even as low end raised
data_conflicts: Triage said fundamentals too distorted by 2024 divestiture; continuing-operations figures in 8-K releases are clean and comparable
d4 trailing EPS $3.00 (GAAP, depressed by one-offs and PA tax effect) vs FY26 adjusted guide $7.20-$7.30
J.confidence_in_thesis: med: strong backlog and guidance trail, but adjusted vs GAAP gap and AI-capex dependence

DOW.thesis_one_line: Big US chemicals maker whose profits just jumped on a war-driven supply squeeze; price already assumes lasting recovery and cash cover is thin.
kill_criteria: Quarterly Operating EBITDA below $1.0B in two consecutive quarters (Q2-26 $2.3B; Q3-25 to Q1-26 range $0.74B-$0.87B).
Quarterly dividend declared below $0.35 a share.
Consolidated net debt above 3.5x TTM Operating EBITDA (now ~2.9x; debt per balance sheet less cash).
TTM free cash flow (CFO less capex, excluding Nova receipts) negative at any 10-Q.
Cumulative cash paid under the Sadara guarantees above $500M (an $80M payment so far in 2026; ~$1.2B of principal guaranteed).
key_adverse_facts: Q2-26 upturn tied to Middle East supply disruption; consensus FY27 EPS $1.75 vs FY26 $2.39
H1-26 free cash flow $1.3B includes about $1.0B one-off Nova receipt; ex-Nova ~$0.3B vs H1 dividends $505M
Sadara: negative investment $793M, ~$1.2B of project debt guaranteed, equity-loss recognition suspended
Net debt ~$14.0B (2.9x TTM Operating EBITDA), pension liability $4.5B, asbestos $663M
No numeric earnings guidance in releases; FY25 GAAP net loss $2.4B and dividend halved in 2025
data_conflicts: Triage net debt/EBITDA 3.8x used Yahoo EBITDA; filings give ~2.9x on TTM Operating EBITDA $4.79B (consolidated)
Triage "negative TTM margin" is stale: Q2-26 GAAP net income $802M and Operating EBIT $1.65B
DOW.confidence_in_thesis: low: cycle-driven earnings, no company guidance, large off-balance-sheet-style exposures

TSCO.thesis_one_line: Farm-and-ranch store chain with loyal rural customers, but sales are slipping, guidance was cut in July and long-term targets were withdrawn.
kill_criteria: Comparable store sales below 0% in both Q3 2026 and Q4 2026 reports.
FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance cut below $1.90 (the low end of the 23 Jul 2026 range).
FY2026 adjusted operating margin rate guidance cut below 8.5% (low end of "8.5% to 8.8%").
Consolidated net debt (10-Q "Total outstanding borrowings" plus finance leases less cash) above 2.0x TTM EBITDA (currently ~1.1x).
The updated long-term framework due with Q4 2026 earnings gives annual EPS growth below 5%.
key_adverse_facts: 23 Jul 2026 FY26 adjusted EPS guide cut to $1.90-$2.00 from $2.13-$2.23; comps guide (1%) to flat from +1% to +3%
Long-term framework from Dec 2024 Investor Day withdrawn
Q2-26 comps -1.5%, transactions -1.7%; inventory +13.9% vs sales +2.3%
TTM FCF (OCF less capex) $307M, ~$590M with sale-leaseback proceeds, vs net income $1.01B
Petsense restructuring: ~75 store closures, $65.8M impairment and other charges
data_conflicts: Triage said guidance was cut twice this year; April 2026 release reaffirmed it, only July cut it
d4 FCF yield 0.6% (Yahoo FCF $103M) vs filing-based TTM OCF-capex $307M
